description:
This video explains how modern AI agents make complex decisions using reinforcement learning, planning, and decision systems. It covers the sequential decision problem, the math behind choices, learning versus planning, and the human alignment challenge. The video also discusses evaluating a system's true capability without falling for benchmark hype.

Report sources:
https://www.gatsby.ucl.ac.uk/~dayan/papers/cjch.pdf
https://www.nature.com/articles/nature14236
https://arxiv.org/abs/1707.06347
thumbnailPrompt: A vivid text-free 16:9 illustration of a robot navigating through a complex environment, with a chessboard or game board in the background, representing the integration of reinforcement learning and planning in decision-making.
title: How AI Agents Make Complex Decisions
